note: BSE 504036 / NSE HIRECT; renamed Hirect Limited (BSE filing 2026-07-24). Six earnings calls in the 8-quarter window: Q4 FY25 (maiden, 2025-05-06) through Q1 FY27 (2026-08-12); Q3 FY25 and Q2 FY25 had no call. Sources: BSE announcement API for 504036 (2024-10-09 to 2026-10-08) and hirect.com corporate-announcement page; transcripts read as full text from the filed PDFs (Q4 FY25, Q1-Q3 FY26 from BSE attachments; Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 from the hirect.com PDFs the BSE letters link to). Page refs are printed transcript pages. Outcomes from the Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 investor presentations (standalone and consolidated P&L, cash flow, order book) and Reg-30 filings. Growth commitments are graded on standalone revenue (management's stated basis, Q4 FY26 p.4/p.6); consolidated also met. Rule 7: 66th AGM transcript (2024-08-01) checked for earlier statements of the 30% target, propulsion trial timeline and margin target - none found; all originating statements lie in the window. Rule 6: no statutory Reg-30 impact statements captured (none encountered in the sources graded). Not captured as promises: sentiment on order pipeline ('absolutely no shortage of orders'), TAM figures, product-wise margin refusals (company never guided margins by product), consolidated FY27 guidance (deferred, never given - not a class-9 withdrawal). Score weights 8->1 by position; null grades drop out. Q4 FY26 grade rests on one item; Q2 FY26 on one item - thin. Recurring pattern: propulsion trial date moved on every call since May 2025 (graded once, at origin).

quarters.label: Q1 FY27
quarters.note: Call 2026-08-12. BSE filing 2026-08-18 is a cover letter pointing to the transcript on hirect.com; text taken from that PDF. Closed-period item (tender finalisation by end Q2 FY27) cannot be verified from filings; no other item has a closed period.

promises.outcome: [not retrieved] - period closed 2026-09-30; no Reg-30 order-receipt filing on BSE between 2026-08-12 and 2026-10-08 (feed checked); whether Railways finalised the tenders is not in any company filing
promises.note: Not graded: tender finalisation is a Railways action and is not filed; absence of an order filing is suggestive but not proof. Re-test on the Q2 FY27 call. CMD opening remarks (p.2-3) said L1/L2/L3 orders 'are expected to come in soon' after slipping out of Q1.

Reasons were given (loco moved from Eastern to Western Railway, approvals), but timeline rule grades lateness: >1 quarter late = 0.
